name: little-blooming-farm
description: Direct-booking site for The Little Blooming Farm — Santa Ynez

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan -k "npm --prefix server run dev:demo" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan -k "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.verify: npm run check:secrets && npm --prefix server run verify
scripts.build: npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
